data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin roots 'rollus' (little wheel) and 'landus' (land). This name was used for a ruler of a land or territory, evoking images of strength and leadership. The name Rolland carries the meaning “Ruler's land” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rolland usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler's land and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rolland total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: The name Rolland bears a strong cultural impact, reflecting a connections to nobility and governance. Historically, this name was common among European nobility and rulers, suggesting a lineage of strong, responsible leaders who were stewards of their communities and lands. The name evokes images of fortitude, strength, and a commitment to upholding the values and ideals of their people. In many cultures and contexts, this name has been synonymous with the power and authority that comes with leadership and governance.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rolland can be seen as a reminder of God's sovereignty over all aspects of life, including rulership and leadership. It can serve as a reminder of our call to be faithful stewards of the gifts, talents, and resources that God has entrusted to us, using them to serve others and build up God's kingdom. The name Rolland also reflects the idea of rolling with the times, trusting in God's guidance and direction for our lives, even in the midst of challenges and uncertainties. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of this name rests in its connection to the notion of service and leadership, inspired by the love and grace of God.
